page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-2xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 32 virtual CPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 12.0 GB per vCPU. The primary hardware accelerators are two NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace family, providing a combined 48 GB of video RAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning external storage volumes must be attached for persistent data. The 32 vCPUs are provisioned under a shared CPU allocation model, which may introduce resource contention compared to dedicated CPU cores. One complimentary public IPv4 address is included with the deployment.

Given the high memory capacity of 384.0 GB and dual NVIDIA L4 GPUs, this instance offers a dense resource profile for memory-intensive and parallel computing tasks. It is designed for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science pipelines, and graphics rendering that benefit from GPU acceleration and large datasets in system memory, though the shared CPU allocation should be factored into predictable compute requirements.
